pages.title: block.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena
pages.text: The Arcane Hunting Grounds reads the boss stored in the Mob Jar above it and produces that boss's unique reward. Its recipe requires a Nether Star, Wilden Tribute, and Dragon's Breath, so those challenges must be completed first.

Place one Mob Jar above the Grounds and at least two Arcane Pedestals within two horizontal blocks. Conjuration Essence supplies 10 points and a Condensed Summoning Core supplies 100. The creature only selects the target.

pages.title: book.ars_arcane_matrix.drygmy_arena.automation.title
pages.text: Default targets include the Wither, Wilden Chimera, and Ender Dragon, producing Nether Stars, Wilden Tributes, and Dragon Eggs. With enough points, a cycle takes five minutes and sends rewards to adjacent containers.

The Grounds never spawns or kills a creature, and creates no experience, boss death sounds, or Wither Roses. Use a Drygmy Henge for ordinary drops and Alakarkinos exploration for structure treasure. Redstone pauses it.
